portableTextConfigs.rendererFile: SPLIT: frontend/app/components/PortableText.tsx (CustomPortableText) used only by InfoSection.tsx and Cta.tsx; the other 5 sites use BARE <PortableText> from @portabletext/react with NO components map
customComponents: CustomPortableText: types.image → SanityImage width 672 cover rounded; block.h1/h2 → anchor-link headings using _key as fragment id; marks.link → ResolvedLink/linkResolver

fetchConfiguration.client: frontend/sanity/lib/client.ts: createClient({useCdn: true, token: SANITY_API_READ_TOKEN (server-only import), stega: {studioUrl}})
fetchConfiguration.live: frontend/sanity/lib/live.ts: defineLive({client, serverToken, browserToken}) — ALL page fetches go through sanityFetch (Live Content API, tag-based auto-revalidation)
fetchConfiguration.staticParams: generateStaticParams uses perspective:'published', stega:false; metadata fetches use stega:false
fetchConfiguration.revalidateRoutes: NOT FOUND — no /api/revalidate webhook route; revalidation is entirely via next-sanity Live (SanityLive component in layout)
fetchConfiguration.draftMode: frontend/app/api/draft-mode/enable/route.ts via defineEnableDraftMode; disable via server action frontend/app/actions.ts; DraftModeToast + VisualEditing in layout when enabled

Embark appears intentionally in schema help text and site/project documentation and may surface only if CMS-authored footer text uses it; no foreign fallback was found.
